Looking for a painter in Randwick?

Sydney Paintmasters is a licensed painting team (Licence 315254C) working across Randwick and the Eastern Suburbs for over 20 years. We paint homes, apartments, strata blocks and commercial sites. Quotes are free, there's no call-out fee, and the price we agree is the price you pay. Call 0423 019 087.

Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Quotes are free and there’s no call-out fee, anywhere in Randwick.
Are you licensed?

What do you paint?
Houses, interiors, exteriors, strata, offices, roofs, pools and epoxy floors.

props.label: Services
props.html:
Our services

Painting services across Randwick

One team, every surface. From a single feature wall to a whole strata block, here's what we handle for Randwick homes and businesses.

House Painting Randwick

Full interior and exterior house repaints, prepped properly and finished clean. We treat your place the way we’d treat our own.

Interior Painting Randwick

Walls, ceilings, cornices, trims and doors. Low-mess methods, tidy cut lines, and colours that suit the light in your rooms.

Exterior Painting Randwick

Weatherboard, render, brick and fibro. We wash off salt, treat mould, and use coatings built for coastal sun and wind.

Office Painting Randwick

Fresh, professional interiors for workplaces. We work around your hours, including early starts and weekends, to keep trading uninterrupted.

Strata Painting Randwick

Common areas, facades and unit blocks, painted with residents still living in. Clear scheduling and respectful crews on every level.

Commercial Painting Randwick

Shopfronts, warehouses and fitouts. Durable finishes, safe site practice, and timelines we actually hold to.

Epoxy Flooring Randwick

Hard-wearing epoxy for garages, workshops and commercial floors. Sealed, slip-aware and easy to keep clean for years.

Pool Painting Randwick

Concrete pool repaints and specialist coatings. Correct prep and the right product so the finish lasts through summer use.

Roof Painting Randwick

Tile and metal roof cleaning, repair and recoat. We lift kerb appeal and add a protective layer against the coastal weather.

props.label: Sec
props.html:
Local painters, Eastern Suburbs

Two decades painting Randwick's homes and buildings

We've spent more than 20 years on ladders and scaffolds across Randwick and the wider Eastern Suburbs. That's a lot of Federation gables, salt-worn renders and busy strata blocks. It taught us what actually lasts here.

Randwick sits high and close to the water. Homes cop salt-laden air, hard sun and wind-driven rain, and cheap paint peels fast because of it. So we don't cut corners on prep. We wash off salt, treat any mould, sand and seal, then use coatings chosen for the surface and the weather it faces.

You get one licensed team from quote to clean-up. No handballing to subcontractors halfway through. Just clear pricing, tidy work, and a finish that still looks right in a few years. Call us. We'll come and take a look.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What we're known for

Three things Randwick calls us for

01

Heritage and period homes

Victorian, Federation and Art Deco homes need a gentler hand. We prepare aged timber, masonry and decorative detail carefully, and match historically appropriate colour schemes so the character stays intact.

02

Coastal, salt-exposed exteriors

Close to the water, exteriors break down faster. We remove salt build-up, treat mould, and apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant systems so the coat holds through Randwick’s sun, wind and humidity.

03

Apartments, terraces and strata

Unit blocks, semis and strata common areas come with people living in them. We plan low-disruption repaints, work around residents, and keep the site clean between visits.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Randwick painting FAQs

Questions we get asked a lot

Straight answers on paint, prep, pricing and guarantees. Anything not here? Just call 0423 019 087.

What paint brands and products do you use?
We use premium trade-grade paint matched to the surface and how much weather it faces. Interiors, coastal exteriors and roofs each call for a different system, so we pick the product for the job rather than defaulting to one tin.
What coatings do you use on coastal, salt-exposed homes?
For exteriors near the water we wash off salt, treat any mould, then apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant coatings. Prep is the part that makes it last. Skip the salt wash and even a good topcoat will lift early.
Do you offer a warranty or guarantee on your work?
We stand behind our prep and our finish, confirmed in writing with your quote so you know exactly what’s covered before we start.
How much does a painter cost in Randwick?
It depends on size, surface condition and how much prep is needed. A single room is very different to a full exterior on a heritage home. We give you a fixed price after seeing the job, so the number in your quote is the number you pay.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Quotes are free and there’s no call-out fee anywhere in Randwick. Book a time, we’ll come and assess, and you’ll get a clear fixed price with no obligation.
Are your painters licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we’re fully insured. Ask and we’ll show you the paperwork before any work begins.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?
Often. Older Randwick homes need careful surface prep and colours that suit the era. We look after aged timber, render and detailing, and we can guide heritage-appropriate schemes so the place keeps its character.
Can you paint occupied strata and apartment buildings?
Yes. Common areas, facades and unit blocks are a big part of what we do. We schedule around residents, keep access clear, and tidy up between stages so daily life keeps moving.
How long does it take to paint a house?
A few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, prep and weather. We give you a realistic timeline after we’ve seen the property, not a guess over the phone.
Can you help me choose colours?
We can. We’ll talk through options for your light, your street and, on period homes, the era of the house. Final call is always yours. We just help you avoid the choices people regret.
Do you do both interior and exterior painting?
Yes, and often on the same job. Interiors, exteriors, roofs, floors and pools. One licensed team handles the lot, so you’re not chasing three different trades.
Do you provide free quotes?
Always. The quote is free, detailed and obligation free. You’ll see exactly what’s included before you decide anything.
What areas of Randwick do you cover?
All of it. Randwick, Coogee, Clovelly, Kensington, Kingsford, Maroubra, Matraville, Malabar, Little Bay, La Perouse, Chifley, Centennial Park, plus Phillip Bay and Port Botany. If you’re in the Randwick council area, we cover you.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Randwick suburbs

Every pocket of Randwick has its own housing stock and its own painting quirks. Here's how we approach the main ones.

Post-war brick · beachfront

Painters in Maroubra

Maroubra is the biggest suburb in the council area, and most of it is solid post-war brick and mid-century homes, with a run of apartments and houses facing the beach. Those beach-facing exteriors take a beating from salt and sun, so they need proper washing and a durable system, not a quick recoat.

We handle full exteriors, interiors and unit blocks right across Maroubra. Whether it’s a family home a few streets back or a balcony line staring at the surf, we prep for the exposure it actually gets.

See our nearby Coogee painting page →
Apartment blocks · rentals

Painters in Kingsford

Kingsford runs along Anzac Parade and leans heavily to apartment blocks and rental housing near the university. That means a lot of between-tenancy repaints and common-area work, usually on a deadline.

We turn interiors around quickly and cleanly, and we’re comfortable working in occupied buildings. Fast prep, tidy lines, and a finish that photographs well for the next lease.

Federation semis · investors

Painters in Kensington

Kensington mixes Federation semis and cottages with newer builds close to UNSW, and a good share are investor owned. Owners here want an interior refresh that lets between tenants, or an exterior that lifts the whole street frontage.

We prep older timber and render carefully and keep the period detail crisp. Quick to quote, clear on timing, easy to deal with for landlords and agents.

Freestanding brick

Painters in Matraville

Matraville is mostly freestanding brick homes, sitting near the industrial belt to the south. Exteriors here pick up grime and weather, and plenty of owners are updating tired 60s and 70s brick with a fresh render coat or a full repaint.

We clean down hard, prime properly, and finish in a colour that modernises the place without fighting the bones of the house.

Coastal estates · render

Painters in Little Bay

Little Bay is newer coastal living, with rendered townhouses and estate homes right on the exposed edge of the peninsula. Render plus salt air is a demanding combination, and recoat cycles come around faster than people expect.

We use flexible, salt and UV-resistant systems built for this exact spot, so your render holds its colour and doesn’t chalk or crack early.

Compare our coastal work in Coogee →
Mid-century · bayside

Painters in Malabar

Malabar sits on the bay with a lot of mid-century homes on the slopes above the water. Weather exposure is real here, especially on the seaward faces. We match the coating to the aspect and give the exposed sides the extra prep they need.

Beachside cottages

Painters in Clovelly

Clovelly is tightly held beachside cottages and semis, and owners here expect a premium finish. Small streets, close neighbours, high standards. We work neat, protect everything, and take the prep seriously so the finish reads as sharp as the street.

Heritage-sensitive colours, clean cut lines, and coatings that stand up to the salt just up the road.

See more beachside work in Coogee →
Heritage cottages · headland

Painters in La Perouse

La Perouse is history on a headland: older cottages and a small, tight community right out on the exposed point, next to Phillip Bay. Being that far out means brutal weathering, so exteriors here live or die on prep.

We scrub off salt, seal weathered timber and masonry, and use tough marine-facing coatings. We cover La Perouse and neighbouring Phillip Bay, and we’re happy to talk through what the exposure means for your recoat timing.

Compact post-war

Painters in Chifley

Chifley is a quiet pocket of compact post-war homes near the coast golf links. Modest houses, honest brick and fibro, and owners who want a clean, cost-sensible repaint done properly. That’s exactly the kind of job we like.

Grand heritage · park fringe

Painters in Centennial Park

On the park fringe you’ll find grand heritage homes and Arts and Crafts residences on generous blocks. These are careful jobs. Original detailing, quality finishes, and colours that respect the age of the house all matter here, and we treat them accordingly.

Painting in Coogee?

Coogee has its own dedicated page. Beachside weathering, salt exposure, render and heritage cottages, all covered in detail there.

Visit the Coogee page

props.label: Services
props.html:
Our services

Painting services across Randwick

One team, every surface. From a single feature wall to a whole strata block, here's what we handle for Randwick homes and businesses.

House Painting Randwick

Full interior and exterior house repaints, prepped properly and finished clean. We treat your place the way we’d treat our own.

Interior Painting Randwick

Walls, ceilings, cornices, trims and doors. Low-mess methods, tidy cut lines, and colours that suit the light in your rooms.

Exterior Painting Randwick

Weatherboard, render, brick and fibro. We wash off salt, treat mould, and use coatings built for coastal sun and wind.

Office Painting Randwick

Fresh, professional interiors for workplaces. We work around your hours, including early starts and weekends, to keep trading uninterrupted.

Strata Painting Randwick

Common areas, facades and unit blocks, painted with residents still living in. Clear scheduling and respectful crews on every level.

Commercial Painting Randwick

Shopfronts, warehouses and fitouts. Durable finishes, safe site practice, and timelines we actually hold to.

Epoxy Flooring Randwick

Hard-wearing epoxy for garages, workshops and commercial floors. Sealed, slip-aware and easy to keep clean for years.

Pool Painting Randwick

Concrete pool repaints and specialist coatings. Correct prep and the right product so the finish lasts through summer use.

Roof Painting Randwick

Tile and metal roof cleaning, repair and recoat. We lift kerb appeal and add a protective layer against the coastal weather.

props.label: Sec
props.html:
Local painters, Eastern Suburbs

Two decades painting Randwick's homes and buildings

We've spent more than 20 years on ladders and scaffolds across Randwick and the wider Eastern Suburbs. That's a lot of Federation gables, salt-worn renders and busy strata blocks. It taught us what actually lasts here.

Randwick sits high and close to the water. Homes cop salt-laden air, hard sun and wind-driven rain, and cheap paint peels fast because of it. So we don't cut corners on prep. We wash off salt, treat any mould, sand and seal, then use coatings chosen for the surface and the weather it faces.

You get one licensed team from quote to clean-up. No handballing to subcontractors halfway through. Just clear pricing, tidy work, and a finish that still looks right in a few years. Call us. We'll come and take a look.

Sydney Paintmasters at a glance

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What we're known for

Three things Randwick calls us for

01

Heritage and period homes

Victorian, Federation and Art Deco homes need a gentler hand. We prepare aged timber, masonry and decorative detail carefully, and match historically appropriate colour schemes so the character stays intact.

02

Coastal, salt-exposed exteriors

Close to the water, exteriors break down faster. We remove salt build-up, treat mould, and apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant systems so the coat holds through Randwick’s sun, wind and humidity.

03

Apartments, terraces and strata

Unit blocks, semis and strata common areas come with people living in them. We plan low-disruption repaints, work around residents, and keep the site clean between visits.

props.label: Faq
props.html:
Randwick painting FAQs

Questions we get asked a lot

Straight answers on paint, prep, pricing and guarantees. Anything not here? Just call 0423 019 087.

What paint brands and products do you use?
We use premium trade-grade paint matched to the surface and how much weather it faces. Interiors, coastal exteriors and roofs each call for a different system, so we pick the product for the job rather than defaulting to one tin.
What coatings do you use on coastal, salt-exposed homes?
For exteriors near the water we wash off salt, treat any mould, then apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant coatings. Prep is the part that makes it last. Skip the salt wash and even a good topcoat will lift early.
Do you offer a warranty or guarantee on your work?
We stand behind our prep and our finish, confirmed in writing with your quote so you know exactly what’s covered before we start.
How much does a painter cost in Randwick?
It depends on size, surface condition and how much prep is needed. A single room is very different to a full exterior on a heritage home. We give you a fixed price after seeing the job, so the number in your quote is the number you pay.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Quotes are free and there’s no call-out fee anywhere in Randwick. Book a time, we’ll come and assess, and you’ll get a clear fixed price with no obligation.
Are your painters licensed and insured?
Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we’re fully insured. Ask and we’ll show you the paperwork before any work begins.
Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?
Often. Older Randwick homes need careful surface prep and colours that suit the era. We look after aged timber, render and detailing, and we can guide heritage-appropriate schemes so the place keeps its character.
Can you paint occupied strata and apartment buildings?
Yes. Common areas, facades and unit blocks are a big part of what we do. We schedule around residents, keep access clear, and tidy up between stages so daily life keeps moving.
How long does it take to paint a house?
A few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, prep and weather. We give you a realistic timeline after we’ve seen the property, not a guess over the phone.
Can you help me choose colours?
We can. We’ll talk through options for your light, your street and, on period homes, the era of the house. Final call is always yours. We just help you avoid the choices people regret.
Do you do both interior and exterior painting?
Yes, and often on the same job. Interiors, exteriors, roofs, floors and pools. One licensed team handles the lot, so you’re not chasing three different trades.
Do you provide free quotes?
Always. The quote is free, detailed and obligation free. You’ll see exactly what’s included before you decide anything.
What areas of Randwick do you cover?
All of it. Randwick, Coogee, Clovelly, Kensington, Kingsford, Maroubra, Matraville, Malabar, Little Bay, La Perouse, Chifley, Centennial Park, plus Phillip Bay and Port Botany. If you’re in the Randwick council area, we cover you.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Randwick suburbs

Every pocket of Randwick has its own housing stock and its own painting quirks. Here's how we approach the main ones.

Post-war brick · beachfront

Painters in Maroubra

Maroubra is the biggest suburb in the council area, and most of it is solid post-war brick and mid-century homes, with a run of apartments and houses facing the beach. Those beach-facing exteriors take a beating from salt and sun, so they need proper washing and a durable system, not a quick recoat.

We handle full exteriors, interiors and unit blocks right across Maroubra. Whether it’s a family home a few streets back or a balcony line staring at the surf, we prep for the exposure it actually gets.

See our nearby Coogee painting page →
Apartment blocks · rentals

Painters in Kingsford

Kingsford runs along Anzac Parade and leans heavily to apartment blocks and rental housing near the university. That means a lot of between-tenancy repaints and common-area work, usually on a deadline.

We turn interiors around quickly and cleanly, and we’re comfortable working in occupied buildings. Fast prep, tidy lines, and a finish that photographs well for the next lease.

Federation semis · investors

Painters in Kensington

Kensington mixes Federation semis and cottages with newer builds close to UNSW, and a good share are investor owned. Owners here want an interior refresh that lets between tenants, or an exterior that lifts the whole street frontage.

We prep older timber and render carefully and keep the period detail crisp. Quick to quote, clear on timing, easy to deal with for landlords and agents.

Freestanding brick

Painters in Matraville

Matraville is mostly freestanding brick homes, sitting near the industrial belt to the south. Exteriors here pick up grime and weather, and plenty of owners are updating tired 60s and 70s brick with a fresh render coat or a full repaint.

We clean down hard, prime properly, and finish in a colour that modernises the place without fighting the bones of the house.

Coastal estates · render

Painters in Little Bay

Little Bay is newer coastal living, with rendered townhouses and estate homes right on the exposed edge of the peninsula. Render plus salt air is a demanding combination, and recoat cycles come around faster than people expect.

We use flexible, salt and UV-resistant systems built for this exact spot, so your render holds its colour and doesn’t chalk or crack early.

Compare our coastal work in Coogee →
Mid-century · bayside

Painters in Malabar

Malabar sits on the bay with a lot of mid-century homes on the slopes above the water. Weather exposure is real here, especially on the seaward faces. We match the coating to the aspect and give the exposed sides the extra prep they need.

Beachside cottages

Painters in Clovelly

Clovelly is tightly held beachside cottages and semis, and owners here expect a premium finish. Small streets, close neighbours, high standards. We work neat, protect everything, and take the prep seriously so the finish reads as sharp as the street.

Heritage-sensitive colours, clean cut lines, and coatings that stand up to the salt just up the road.

See more beachside work in Coogee →
Heritage cottages · headland

Painters in La Perouse

La Perouse is history on a headland: older cottages and a small, tight community right out on the exposed point, next to Phillip Bay. Being that far out means brutal weathering, so exteriors here live or die on prep.

We scrub off salt, seal weathered timber and masonry, and use tough marine-facing coatings. We cover La Perouse and neighbouring Phillip Bay, and we’re happy to talk through what the exposure means for your recoat timing.

Compact post-war

Painters in Chifley

Chifley is a quiet pocket of compact post-war homes near the coast golf links. Modest houses, honest brick and fibro, and owners who want a clean, cost-sensible repaint done properly. That’s exactly the kind of job we like.

Grand heritage · park fringe

Painters in Centennial Park

On the park fringe you’ll find grand heritage homes and Arts and Crafts residences on generous blocks. These are careful jobs. Original detailing, quality finishes, and colours that respect the age of the house all matter here, and we treat them accordingly.

Painting in Coogee?

Coogee has its own dedicated page. Beachside weathering, salt exposure, render and heritage cottages, all covered in detail there.

Visit the Coogee page

props.label: Services
props.html:
Our services

Painting services across Randwick

One team, every surface. From a single feature wall to a whole strata block, here's what we handle for Randwick homes and businesses.

House Painting Randwick

Full interior and exterior house repaints, prepped properly and finished clean. We treat your place the way we’d treat our own.

Interior Painting Randwick

Walls, ceilings, cornices, trims and doors. Low-mess methods, tidy cut lines, and colours that suit the light in your rooms.

Exterior Painting Randwick

Weatherboard, render, brick and fibro. We wash off salt, treat mould, and use coatings built for coastal sun and wind.

Office Painting Randwick

Fresh, professional interiors for workplaces. We work around your hours, including early starts and weekends, to keep trading uninterrupted.

Strata Painting Randwick

Common areas, facades and unit blocks, painted with residents still living in. Clear scheduling and respectful crews on every level.

Commercial Painting Randwick

Shopfronts, warehouses and fitouts. Durable finishes, safe site practice, and timelines we actually hold to.

Epoxy Flooring Randwick

Hard-wearing epoxy for garages, workshops and commercial floors. Sealed, slip-aware and easy to keep clean for years.

Pool Painting Randwick

Concrete pool repaints and specialist coatings. Correct prep and the right product so the finish lasts through summer use.

Roof Painting Randwick

Tile and metal roof cleaning, repair and recoat. We lift kerb appeal and add a protective layer against the coastal weather.

props.label: Sec
props.html:
Local painters, Eastern Suburbs

Two decades painting Randwick's homes and buildings

We've spent more than 20 years on ladders and scaffolds across Randwick and the wider Eastern Suburbs. That's a lot of Federation gables, salt-worn renders and busy strata blocks. It taught us what actually lasts here.

Randwick sits high and close to the water. Homes cop salt-laden air, hard sun and wind-driven rain, and cheap paint peels fast because of it. So we don't cut corners on prep. We wash off salt, treat any mould, sand and seal, then use coatings chosen for the surface and the weather it faces.

You get one licensed team from quote to clean-up. No handballing to subcontractors halfway through. Just clear pricing, tidy work, and a finish that still looks right in a few years. Call us. We'll come and take a look.

props.label: Specialties
props.html:
What we're known for

Three things Randwick calls us for

01

Heritage and period homes

Victorian, Federation and Art Deco homes need a gentler hand. We prepare aged timber, masonry and decorative detail carefully, and match historically appropriate colour schemes so the character stays intact.

02

Coastal, salt-exposed exteriors

Close to the water, exteriors break down faster. We remove salt build-up, treat mould, and apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant systems so the coat holds through Randwick’s sun, wind and humidity.

03

Apartments, terraces and strata

Unit blocks, semis and strata common areas come with people living in them. We plan low-disruption repaints, work around residents, and keep the site clean between visits.

Straight answers on paint, prep, pricing and guarantees. Anything not here? Just call 0423 019 087.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Randwick suburbs

Every pocket of Randwick has its own housing stock and its own painting quirks. Here's how we approach the main ones.

Post-war brick · beachfront

Painters in Maroubra

Maroubra is the biggest suburb in the council area, and most of it is solid post-war brick and mid-century homes, with a run of apartments and houses facing the beach. Those beach-facing exteriors take a beating from salt and sun, so they need proper washing and a durable system, not a quick recoat.

We handle full exteriors, interiors and unit blocks right across Maroubra. Whether it’s a family home a few streets back or a balcony line staring at the surf, we prep for the exposure it actually gets.

See our nearby Coogee painting page →
Apartment blocks · rentals

Painters in Kingsford

Kingsford runs along Anzac Parade and leans heavily to apartment blocks and rental housing near the university. That means a lot of between-tenancy repaints and common-area work, usually on a deadline.

We turn interiors around quickly and cleanly, and we’re comfortable working in occupied buildings. Fast prep, tidy lines, and a finish that photographs well for the next lease.

Federation semis · investors

Painters in Kensington

Kensington mixes Federation semis and cottages with newer builds close to UNSW, and a good share are investor owned. Owners here want an interior refresh that lets between tenants, or an exterior that lifts the whole street frontage.

We prep older timber and render carefully and keep the period detail crisp. Quick to quote, clear on timing, easy to deal with for landlords and agents.

Freestanding brick

Painters in Matraville

Matraville is mostly freestanding brick homes, sitting near the industrial belt to the south. Exteriors here pick up grime and weather, and plenty of owners are updating tired 60s and 70s brick with a fresh render coat or a full repaint.

We clean down hard, prime properly, and finish in a colour that modernises the place without fighting the bones of the house.

Coastal estates · render

Painters in Little Bay

Little Bay is newer coastal living, with rendered townhouses and estate homes right on the exposed edge of the peninsula. Render plus salt air is a demanding combination, and recoat cycles come around faster than people expect.

We use flexible, salt and UV-resistant systems built for this exact spot, so your render holds its colour and doesn’t chalk or crack early.

Compare our coastal work in Coogee →
Mid-century · bayside

Painters in Malabar

Malabar sits on the bay with a lot of mid-century homes on the slopes above the water. Weather exposure is real here, especially on the seaward faces. We match the coating to the aspect and give the exposed sides the extra prep they need.

Beachside cottages

Painters in Clovelly

Clovelly is tightly held beachside cottages and semis, and owners here expect a premium finish. Small streets, close neighbours, high standards. We work neat, protect everything, and take the prep seriously so the finish reads as sharp as the street.

Heritage-sensitive colours, clean cut lines, and coatings that stand up to the salt just up the road.

See more beachside work in Coogee →
Heritage cottages · headland

Painters in La Perouse

La Perouse is history on a headland: older cottages and a small, tight community right out on the exposed point, next to Phillip Bay. Being that far out means brutal weathering, so exteriors here live or die on prep.

We scrub off salt, seal weathered timber and masonry, and use tough marine-facing coatings. We cover La Perouse and neighbouring Phillip Bay, and we’re happy to talk through what the exposure means for your recoat timing.

Compact post-war

Painters in Chifley

Chifley is a quiet pocket of compact post-war homes near the coast golf links. Modest houses, honest brick and fibro, and owners who want a clean, cost-sensible repaint done properly. That’s exactly the kind of job we like.

Grand heritage · park fringe

Painters in Centennial Park

On the park fringe you’ll find grand heritage homes and Arts and Crafts residences on generous blocks. These are careful jobs. Original detailing, quality finishes, and colours that respect the age of the house all matter here, and we treat them accordingly.

Painting in Coogee?

Coogee has its own dedicated page. Beachside weathering, salt exposure, render and heritage cottages, all covered in detail there.

Visit the Coogee page

data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across Randwick and Sydney’s eastern suburbs for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands and products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade-grade paint matched to the surface and how much weather it faces. Interiors, coastal exteriors and roofs each call for a different system, so we pick the product for the job rather than defaulting to one tin.

mainEntity.name: What coatings do you use on coastal, salt-exposed homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exteriors near the water we wash off salt, treat any mould, then apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant coatings. Prep is the part that makes it last. Skip the salt wash and even a good topcoat will lift early.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a warranty or guarantee on your work?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind our prep and our finish, confirmed in writing with your quote so you know exactly what’s covered before we start.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost in Randwick?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on size, surface condition and how much prep is needed. A single room is very different to a full exterior on a heritage home. We give you a fixed price after seeing the job, so the number in your quote is the number you pay.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Quotes are free and there’s no call-out fee anywhere in Randwick. Book a time, we’ll come and assess, and you’ll get a clear fixed price with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: Are your painters licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we’re fully insured. Ask and we’ll show you the paperwork before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often. Older Randwick homes need careful surface prep and colours that suit the era. We look after aged timber, render and detailing, and we can guide heritage-appropriate schemes so the place keeps its character.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint occupied strata and apartment buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Common areas, facades and unit blocks are a big part of what we do. We schedule around residents, keep access clear, and tidy up between stages so daily life keeps moving.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, prep and weather. We give you a realistic timeline after we’ve seen the property, not a guess over the phone.

mainEntity.name: Can you help me choose colours?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can. We’ll talk through options for your light, your street and, on period homes, the era of the house. Final call is always yours. We just help you avoid the choices people regret.

mainEntity.name: Do you do both interior and exterior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and often on the same job. Interiors, exteriors, roofs, floors and pools. One licensed team handles the lot, so you’re not chasing three different trades.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide free quotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Always. The quote is free, detailed and obligation free. You’ll see exactly what’s included before you decide anything.

mainEntity.name: What areas of Randwick do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of it. Randwick, Coogee, Clovelly, Kensington, Kingsford, Maroubra, Matraville, Malabar, Little Bay, La Perouse, Chifley, Centennial Park, plus Phillip Bay and Port Botany. If you’re in the Randwick council area, we cover you.

Two decades painting Randwick's homes and buildings

We've spent more than 20 years on ladders and scaffolds across Randwick and the wider Eastern Suburbs. That's a lot of Federation gables, salt-worn renders and busy strata blocks. It taught us what actually lasts here.

Randwick sits high and close to the water. Homes cop salt-laden air, hard sun and wind-driven rain, and cheap paint peels fast because of it. So we don't cut corners on prep. We wash off salt, treat any mould, sand and seal, then use coatings chosen for the surface and the weather it faces.

You get one licensed team from quote to clean-up. No handballing to subcontractors halfway through. Just clear pricing, tidy work, and a finish that still looks right in a few years. Call us. We'll come and take a look.

Unit blocks, semis and strata common areas come with people living in them. We plan low-disruption repaints, work around residents, and keep the site clean between visits.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Randwick suburbs

Every pocket of Randwick has its own housing stock and its own painting quirks. Here's how we approach the main ones.

Post-war brick · beachfront

Painters in Maroubra

Maroubra is the biggest suburb in the council area, and most of it is solid post-war brick and mid-century homes, with a run of apartments and houses facing the beach. Those beach-facing exteriors take a beating from salt and sun, so they need proper washing and a durable system, not a quick recoat.

We handle full exteriors, interiors and unit blocks right across Maroubra. Whether it’s a family home a few streets back or a balcony line staring at the surf, we prep for the exposure it actually gets.

See our nearby Coogee painting page →
Apartment blocks · rentals

Painters in Kingsford

Kingsford runs along Anzac Parade and leans heavily to apartment blocks and rental housing near the university. That means a lot of between-tenancy repaints and common-area work, usually on a deadline.

We turn interiors around quickly and cleanly, and we’re comfortable working in occupied buildings. Fast prep, tidy lines, and a finish that photographs well for the next lease.

Federation semis · investors

Painters in Kensington

Kensington mixes Federation semis and cottages with newer builds close to UNSW, and a good share are investor owned. Owners here want an interior refresh that lets between tenants, or an exterior that lifts the whole street frontage.

We prep older timber and render carefully and keep the period detail crisp. Quick to quote, clear on timing, easy to deal with for landlords and agents.

Freestanding brick

Painters in Matraville

Matraville is mostly freestanding brick homes, sitting near the industrial belt to the south. Exteriors here pick up grime and weather, and plenty of owners are updating tired 60s and 70s brick with a fresh render coat or a full repaint.

We clean down hard, prime properly, and finish in a colour that modernises the place without fighting the bones of the house.

Coastal estates · render

Painters in Little Bay

Little Bay is newer coastal living, with rendered townhouses and estate homes right on the exposed edge of the peninsula. Render plus salt air is a demanding combination, and recoat cycles come around faster than people expect.

We use flexible, salt and UV-resistant systems built for this exact spot, so your render holds its colour and doesn’t chalk or crack early.

Compare our coastal work in Coogee →
Mid-century · bayside

Painters in Malabar

Malabar sits on the bay with a lot of mid-century homes on the slopes above the water. Weather exposure is real here, especially on the seaward faces. We match the coating to the aspect and give the exposed sides the extra prep they need.

Beachside cottages

Painters in Clovelly

Clovelly is tightly held beachside cottages and semis, and owners here expect a premium finish. Small streets, close neighbours, high standards. We work neat, protect everything, and take the prep seriously so the finish reads as sharp as the street.

Heritage-sensitive colours, clean cut lines, and coatings that stand up to the salt just up the road.

See more beachside work in Coogee →
Heritage cottages · headland

Painters in La Perouse

La Perouse is history on a headland: older cottages and a small, tight community right out on the exposed point, next to Phillip Bay. Being that far out means brutal weathering, so exteriors here live or die on prep.

We scrub off salt, seal weathered timber and masonry, and use tough marine-facing coatings. We cover La Perouse and neighbouring Phillip Bay, and we’re happy to talk through what the exposure means for your recoat timing.

Compact post-war

Painters in Chifley

Chifley is a quiet pocket of compact post-war homes near the coast golf links. Modest houses, honest brick and fibro, and owners who want a clean, cost-sensible repaint done properly. That’s exactly the kind of job we like.

Grand heritage · park fringe

Painters in Centennial Park

On the park fringe you’ll find grand heritage homes and Arts and Crafts residences on generous blocks. These are careful jobs. Original detailing, quality finishes, and colours that respect the age of the house all matter here, and we treat them accordingly.

Painting in Coogee?

Coogee has its own dedicated page. Beachside weathering, salt exposure, render and heritage cottages, all covered in detail there.

Visit the Coogee page

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed painting business covering the Randwick City council area and the Eastern Suburbs for 20+ years. House, interior, exterior, strata, roof, commercial, epoxy and pool painting, with free fixed-price quotes and no call-out fee.

data.name: Bobby Nojad
data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across Randwick and Sydney’s eastern suburbs for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands and products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade-grade paint matched to the surface and how much weather it faces. Interiors, coastal exteriors and roofs each call for a different system, so we pick the product for the job rather than defaulting to one tin.

mainEntity.name: What coatings do you use on coastal, salt-exposed homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exteriors near the water we wash off salt, treat any mould, then apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant coatings. Prep is the part that makes it last. Skip the salt wash and even a good topcoat will lift early.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a warranty or guarantee on your work?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind our prep and our finish, confirmed in writing with your quote so you know exactly what’s covered before we start.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost in Randwick?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on size, surface condition and how much prep is needed. A single room is very different to a full exterior on a heritage home. We give you a fixed price after seeing the job, so the number in your quote is the number you pay.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Quotes are free and there’s no call-out fee anywhere in Randwick. Book a time, we’ll come and assess, and you’ll get a clear fixed price with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: Are your painters licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we’re fully insured. Ask and we’ll show you the paperwork before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often. Older Randwick homes need careful surface prep and colours that suit the era. We look after aged timber, render and detailing, and we can guide heritage-appropriate schemes so the place keeps its character.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint occupied strata and apartment buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Common areas, facades and unit blocks are a big part of what we do. We schedule around residents, keep access clear, and tidy up between stages so daily life keeps moving.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, prep and weather. We give you a realistic timeline after we’ve seen the property, not a guess over the phone.

mainEntity.name: Can you help me choose colours?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can. We’ll talk through options for your light, your street and, on period homes, the era of the house. Final call is always yours. We just help you avoid the choices people regret.

mainEntity.name: Do you do both interior and exterior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and often on the same job. Interiors, exteriors, roofs, floors and pools. One licensed team handles the lot, so you’re not chasing three different trades.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide free quotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Always. The quote is free, detailed and obligation free. You’ll see exactly what’s included before you decide anything.

mainEntity.name: What areas of Randwick do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of it. Randwick, Coogee, Clovelly, Kensington, Kingsford, Maroubra, Matraville, Malabar, Little Bay, La Perouse, Chifley, Centennial Park, plus Phillip Bay and Port Botany. If you’re in the Randwick council area, we cover you.

We've spent more than 20 years on ladders and scaffolds across Randwick and the wider Eastern Suburbs. That's a lot of Federation gables, salt-worn renders and busy strata blocks. It taught us what actually lasts here.

Randwick sits high and close to the water. Homes cop salt-laden air, hard sun and wind-driven rain, and cheap paint peels fast because of it. So we don't cut corners on prep. We wash off salt, treat any mould, sand and seal, then use coatings chosen for the surface and the weather it faces.

You get one licensed team from quote to clean-up. No handballing to subcontractors halfway through. Just clear pricing, tidy work, and a finish that still looks right in a few years. Call us. We'll come and take a look.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Randwick suburbs

Every pocket of Randwick has its own housing stock and its own painting quirks. Here's how we approach the main ones.

Post-war brick · beachfront

Painters in Maroubra

Maroubra is the biggest suburb in the council area, and most of it is solid post-war brick and mid-century homes, with a run of apartments and houses facing the beach. Those beach-facing exteriors take a beating from salt and sun, so they need proper washing and a durable system, not a quick recoat.

We handle full exteriors, interiors and unit blocks right across Maroubra. Whether it’s a family home a few streets back or a balcony line staring at the surf, we prep for the exposure it actually gets.

See our nearby Coogee painting page →
Apartment blocks · rentals

Painters in Kingsford

Kingsford runs along Anzac Parade and leans heavily to apartment blocks and rental housing near the university. That means a lot of between-tenancy repaints and common-area work, usually on a deadline.

We turn interiors around quickly and cleanly, and we’re comfortable working in occupied buildings. Fast prep, tidy lines, and a finish that photographs well for the next lease.

Federation semis · investors

Painters in Kensington

Kensington mixes Federation semis and cottages with newer builds close to UNSW, and a good share are investor owned. Owners here want an interior refresh that lets between tenants, or an exterior that lifts the whole street frontage.

We prep older timber and render carefully and keep the period detail crisp. Quick to quote, clear on timing, easy to deal with for landlords and agents.

Freestanding brick

Painters in Matraville

Matraville is mostly freestanding brick homes, sitting near the industrial belt to the south. Exteriors here pick up grime and weather, and plenty of owners are updating tired 60s and 70s brick with a fresh render coat or a full repaint.

We clean down hard, prime properly, and finish in a colour that modernises the place without fighting the bones of the house.

Coastal estates · render

Painters in Little Bay

Little Bay is newer coastal living, with rendered townhouses and estate homes right on the exposed edge of the peninsula. Render plus salt air is a demanding combination, and recoat cycles come around faster than people expect.

We use flexible, salt and UV-resistant systems built for this exact spot, so your render holds its colour and doesn’t chalk or crack early.

Compare our coastal work in Coogee →
Mid-century · bayside

Painters in Malabar

Malabar sits on the bay with a lot of mid-century homes on the slopes above the water. Weather exposure is real here, especially on the seaward faces. We match the coating to the aspect and give the exposed sides the extra prep they need.

Beachside cottages

Painters in Clovelly

Clovelly is tightly held beachside cottages and semis, and owners here expect a premium finish. Small streets, close neighbours, high standards. We work neat, protect everything, and take the prep seriously so the finish reads as sharp as the street.

Heritage-sensitive colours, clean cut lines, and coatings that stand up to the salt just up the road.

See more beachside work in Coogee →
Heritage cottages · headland

Painters in La Perouse

La Perouse is history on a headland: older cottages and a small, tight community right out on the exposed point, next to Phillip Bay. Being that far out means brutal weathering, so exteriors here live or die on prep.

We scrub off salt, seal weathered timber and masonry, and use tough marine-facing coatings. We cover La Perouse and neighbouring Phillip Bay, and we’re happy to talk through what the exposure means for your recoat timing.

Compact post-war

Painters in Chifley

Chifley is a quiet pocket of compact post-war homes near the coast golf links. Modest houses, honest brick and fibro, and owners who want a clean, cost-sensible repaint done properly. That’s exactly the kind of job we like.

Grand heritage · park fringe

Painters in Centennial Park

On the park fringe you’ll find grand heritage homes and Arts and Crafts residences on generous blocks. These are careful jobs. Original detailing, quality finishes, and colours that respect the age of the house all matter here, and we treat them accordingly.

Painting in Coogee?

Coogee has its own dedicated page. Beachside weathering, salt exposure, render and heritage cottages, all covered in detail there.

Visit the Coogee page

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed painting business covering the Randwick City council area and the Eastern Suburbs for 20+ years. House, interior, exterior, strata, roof, commercial, epoxy and pool painting, with free fixed-price quotes and no call-out fee.

data.name: Bobby Nojad
data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across Randwick and Sydney’s eastern suburbs for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands and products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade-grade paint matched to the surface and how much weather it faces. Interiors, coastal exteriors and roofs each call for a different system, so we pick the product for the job rather than defaulting to one tin.

mainEntity.name: What coatings do you use on coastal, salt-exposed homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exteriors near the water we wash off salt, treat any mould, then apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant coatings. Prep is the part that makes it last. Skip the salt wash and even a good topcoat will lift early.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a warranty or guarantee on your work?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind our prep and our finish, confirmed in writing with your quote so you know exactly what’s covered before we start.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost in Randwick?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on size, surface condition and how much prep is needed. A single room is very different to a full exterior on a heritage home. We give you a fixed price after seeing the job, so the number in your quote is the number you pay.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Quotes are free and there’s no call-out fee anywhere in Randwick. Book a time, we’ll come and assess, and you’ll get a clear fixed price with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: Are your painters licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we’re fully insured. Ask and we’ll show you the paperwork before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often. Older Randwick homes need careful surface prep and colours that suit the era. We look after aged timber, render and detailing, and we can guide heritage-appropriate schemes so the place keeps its character.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint occupied strata and apartment buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Common areas, facades and unit blocks are a big part of what we do. We schedule around residents, keep access clear, and tidy up between stages so daily life keeps moving.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, prep and weather. We give you a realistic timeline after we’ve seen the property, not a guess over the phone.

mainEntity.name: Can you help me choose colours?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can. We’ll talk through options for your light, your street and, on period homes, the era of the house. Final call is always yours. We just help you avoid the choices people regret.

mainEntity.name: Do you do both interior and exterior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and often on the same job. Interiors, exteriors, roofs, floors and pools. One licensed team handles the lot, so you’re not chasing three different trades.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide free quotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Always. The quote is free, detailed and obligation free. You’ll see exactly what’s included before you decide anything.

mainEntity.name: What areas of Randwick do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of it. Randwick, Coogee, Clovelly, Kensington, Kingsford, Maroubra, Matraville, Malabar, Little Bay, La Perouse, Chifley, Centennial Park, plus Phillip Bay and Port Botany. If you’re in the Randwick council area, we cover you.

Two decades painting Randwick's homes and buildings

We've spent more than 20 years on ladders and scaffolds across Randwick and the wider Eastern Suburbs. That's a lot of Federation gables, salt-worn renders and busy strata blocks. It taught us what actually lasts here.

Randwick sits high and close to the water. Homes cop salt-laden air, hard sun and wind-driven rain, and cheap paint peels fast because of it. So we don't cut corners on prep. We wash off salt, treat any mould, sand and seal, then use coatings chosen for the surface and the weather it faces.

You get one licensed team from quote to clean-up. No handballing to subcontractors halfway through. Just clear pricing, tidy work, and a finish that still looks right in a few years. Call us. We'll come and take a look.

Unit blocks, semis and strata common areas come with people living in them. We plan low-disruption repaints, work around residents, and keep the site clean between visits.

props.label: Areas
props.html:
Suburb by suburb

Painters across the Randwick suburbs

Every pocket of Randwick has its own housing stock and its own painting quirks. Here's how we approach the main ones.

Post-war brick · beachfront

Painters in Maroubra

Maroubra is the biggest suburb in the council area, and most of it is solid post-war brick and mid-century homes, with a run of apartments and houses facing the beach. Those beach-facing exteriors take a beating from salt and sun, so they need proper washing and a durable system, not a quick recoat.

We handle full exteriors, interiors and unit blocks right across Maroubra. Whether it’s a family home a few streets back or a balcony line staring at the surf, we prep for the exposure it actually gets.

See our nearby Coogee painting page →
Apartment blocks · rentals

Painters in Kingsford

Kingsford runs along Anzac Parade and leans heavily to apartment blocks and rental housing near the university. That means a lot of between-tenancy repaints and common-area work, usually on a deadline.

We turn interiors around quickly and cleanly, and we’re comfortable working in occupied buildings. Fast prep, tidy lines, and a finish that photographs well for the next lease.

Federation semis · investors

Painters in Kensington

Kensington mixes Federation semis and cottages with newer builds close to UNSW, and a good share are investor owned. Owners here want an interior refresh that lets between tenants, or an exterior that lifts the whole street frontage.

We prep older timber and render carefully and keep the period detail crisp. Quick to quote, clear on timing, easy to deal with for landlords and agents.

Freestanding brick

Painters in Matraville

Matraville is mostly freestanding brick homes, sitting near the industrial belt to the south. Exteriors here pick up grime and weather, and plenty of owners are updating tired 60s and 70s brick with a fresh render coat or a full repaint.

We clean down hard, prime properly, and finish in a colour that modernises the place without fighting the bones of the house.

Coastal estates · render

Painters in Little Bay

Little Bay is newer coastal living, with rendered townhouses and estate homes right on the exposed edge of the peninsula. Render plus salt air is a demanding combination, and recoat cycles come around faster than people expect.

We use flexible, salt and UV-resistant systems built for this exact spot, so your render holds its colour and doesn’t chalk or crack early.

Compare our coastal work in Coogee →
Mid-century · bayside

Painters in Malabar

Malabar sits on the bay with a lot of mid-century homes on the slopes above the water. Weather exposure is real here, especially on the seaward faces. We match the coating to the aspect and give the exposed sides the extra prep they need.

Beachside cottages

Painters in Clovelly

Clovelly is tightly held beachside cottages and semis, and owners here expect a premium finish. Small streets, close neighbours, high standards. We work neat, protect everything, and take the prep seriously so the finish reads as sharp as the street.

Heritage-sensitive colours, clean cut lines, and coatings that stand up to the salt just up the road.

See more beachside work in Coogee →
Heritage cottages · headland

Painters in La Perouse

La Perouse is history on a headland: older cottages and a small, tight community right out on the exposed point, next to Phillip Bay. Being that far out means brutal weathering, so exteriors here live or die on prep.

We scrub off salt, seal weathered timber and masonry, and use tough marine-facing coatings. We cover La Perouse and neighbouring Phillip Bay, and we’re happy to talk through what the exposure means for your recoat timing.

Compact post-war

Painters in Chifley

Chifley is a quiet pocket of compact post-war homes near the coast golf links. Modest houses, honest brick and fibro, and owners who want a clean, cost-sensible repaint done properly. That’s exactly the kind of job we like.

Grand heritage · park fringe

Painters in Centennial Park

On the park fringe you’ll find grand heritage homes and Arts and Crafts residences on generous blocks. These are careful jobs. Original detailing, quality finishes, and colours that respect the age of the house all matter here, and we treat them accordingly.

Painting in Coogee?

Coogee has its own dedicated page. Beachside weathering, salt exposure, render and heritage cottages, all covered in detail there.

Visit the Coogee page

The team

Real painters, on the tools, every job

Sydney Paintmasters is a hands-on local team, not a call centre that subcontracts your job to whoever's free. The same licensed crew that quotes your place is the crew that preps and paints it.

.mobile-submenu[hidden]{display:none}
header .nav>ul>li:hover>ul{opacity:1!important;visibility:visible!important;transform:translateY(0)!important}

/* clone-only: quote popup */
.spm-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:none}
.spm-modal.open{display:block}
.spm-modal__backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(28,41,63,.62);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);opacity:0;transition:opacity .22s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__backdrop{opacity:1}
.spm-modal__scroll{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;padding:24px 16px 40px}
.spm-modal__dialog{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:520px;margin:auto;transform:translateY(16px) scale(.98);opacity:0;transition:transform .24s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1),opacity .24s ease}
.spm-modal.open .spm-modal__dialog{transform:none;opacity:1}
.spm-modal__dialog>div{max-width:none!important;width:100%}
.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:46px}
.spm-modal__close{position:absolute;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:3;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;border:none;background:var(--light,#f0f0fa);color:var(--navy,#1c293f);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .18s ease,color .18s ease,transform .18s ease}
.spm-modal__close:hover{background:var(--primary,#016edc);color:#fff;transform:rotate(90deg)}
.spm-modal__close:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent,#ffa800);outline-offset:2px}
@media(max-width:520px){.spm-modal__close{top:14px;right:14px;width:32px;height:32px}.spm-modal__dialog h2,.spm-modal__dialog h3{padding-right:40px}}
body.spm-modal-open{overflow:hidden}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.spm-modal__backdrop,.spm-modal__dialog{transition:none}}

data.name: Sydney Paintmasters
data.description: Licensed painting business covering the Randwick City council area and the Eastern Suburbs for 20+ years. House, interior, exterior, strata, roof, commercial, epoxy and pool painting, with free fixed-price quotes and no call-out fee.

data.name: Bobby Nojad
data.description: Licensed painter (315254C) leading Sydney Paintmasters across Randwick and Sydney’s eastern suburbs for 20+ years.

mainEntity.name: What paint brands and products do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use premium trade-grade paint matched to the surface and how much weather it faces. Interiors, coastal exteriors and roofs each call for a different system, so we pick the product for the job rather than defaulting to one tin.

mainEntity.name: What coatings do you use on coastal, salt-exposed homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: For exteriors near the water we wash off salt, treat any mould, then apply flexible, UV and moisture-resistant coatings. Prep is the part that makes it last. Skip the salt wash and even a good topcoat will lift early.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer a warranty or guarantee on your work?

acceptedAnswer.text: We stand behind our prep and our finish, confirmed in writing with your quote so you know exactly what’s covered before we start.

mainEntity.name: How much does a painter cost in Randwick?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on size, surface condition and how much prep is needed. A single room is very different to a full exterior on a heritage home. We give you a fixed price after seeing the job, so the number in your quote is the number you pay.

mainEntity.name: Do you charge a call-out fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Quotes are free and there’s no call-out fee anywhere in Randwick. Book a time, we’ll come and assess, and you’ll get a clear fixed price with no obligation.

mainEntity.name: Are your painters licensed and insured?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We hold Painter Decorator Licence 315254C and we’re fully insured. Ask and we’ll show you the paperwork before any work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you paint heritage and Federation homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often. Older Randwick homes need careful surface prep and colours that suit the era. We look after aged timber, render and detailing, and we can guide heritage-appropriate schemes so the place keeps its character.

mainEntity.name: Can you paint occupied strata and apartment buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Common areas, facades and unit blocks are a big part of what we do. We schedule around residents, keep access clear, and tidy up between stages so daily life keeps moving.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a house?

acceptedAnswer.text: A few days to a couple of weeks, depending on size, prep and weather. We give you a realistic timeline after we’ve seen the property, not a guess over the phone.

mainEntity.name: Can you help me choose colours?

acceptedAnswer.text: We can. We’ll talk through options for your light, your street and, on period homes, the era of the house. Final call is always yours. We just help you avoid the choices people regret.

mainEntity.name: Do you do both interior and exterior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and often on the same job. Interiors, exteriors, roofs, floors and pools. One licensed team handles the lot, so you’re not chasing three different trades.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide free quotes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Always. The quote is free, detailed and obligation free. You’ll see exactly what’s included before you decide anything.

mainEntity.name: What areas of Randwick do you cover?

acceptedAnswer.text: All of it. Randwick, Coogee, Clovelly, Kensington, Kingsford, Maroubra, Matraville, Malabar, Little Bay, La Perouse, Chifley, Centennial Park, plus Phillip Bay and Port Botany. If you’re in the Randwick council area, we cover you.
